---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(region))

country_attacks <- attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Country_lower)) |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

world |>
  left_join(country_attacks, by = c("region" = "Country_lower")) |>
  mutate(attacks = replace_na(attacks, 0L)) |>
  ggplot(aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Shark attacks", trans = "sqrt") +
  theme_void()
```
